channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: AgentKit Beta 3 adds GitHub Copilot runtime support and Ollama context-window discovery
item.description: AgentKit Beta 3 adds GitHub Copilot runtime support and Ollama context-window discovery, moving toward agents that work across providers and local models.

item.title: Gauge raises $500K seed to track how AI agents pick software
item.description: Gauge raised a $500,000 seed round to track how AI agents discover and choose software, as agents start buying tools inside developer environments.

item.title: Noeri launches with $110M led by Menlo Ventures to build self-improving AI
item.description: Noeri launched with $110 million in initial funding led by Menlo Ventures to build self-improving AI for enterprises and researchers.

item.title: Base44 launches Production Agent to watch published apps and suggest one-click fixes
item.description: Base44 launched Production Agent, which watches published apps for errors, suggests one-click fixes, and can send email alerts when issues recur.

item.title: System 1 agents: local agents that never generate text, 92.9% correct on 1,952 tool requests
item.description: A new preprint describes 'System 1 agents' — local AI agents that never generate text and scored 92.9% correct across nearly 2,000 tool requests.

item.title: Sierra in talks to raise ~$1.5B at a ~$30B valuation, nearly doubling its May price
item.description: Sierra is reportedly in talks to raise about $1.5B at a $30B valuation, nearly double its May price, after passing $400M in annual recurring revenue.

item.title: BMW's playbook for governing hundreds of AI agents across 12,500 developers
item.description: BMW shared how it governs hundreds of AI agents across 12,500 developers, with rules enforced outside the agent and different approval levels for each step.

item.title: SnapLogic launches MCP Discovery Hub, a central registry for MCP servers and tools
item.description: SnapLogic launched a central registry for discovering and reusing MCP servers and tools, with governance and observability built in.

item.title: Model ML raises $250M Series B at $1.5B valuation to put personal AI agents on bankers' desks
item.description: Model ML raised a $250 million Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation to build personal AI agents for bankers and consultants.

item.title: Axle raises $9M to add AI agents to investment-bank meeting scheduling
item.description: Axle raised $9 million to add AI agents to investment-bank meeting scheduling.

item.title: Atlan brings data governance to MCP: agents read owners, lineage and policies, changes wait for approval
item.description: Atlan's MCP server now lets AI agents read data owners, lineage and policies, with any metadata change waiting for human approval.

item.title: AI agents can now pay on XDC in USDC via x402
item.description: AI agents can now pay in USDC on the XDC network via the open x402 payment standard.

item.title: Modern Industrials raises $6M seed to build custom AI agents for manufacturers and distributors
item.description: Modern Industrials raised a $6 million seed round to build custom AI agents for manufacturers and distributors.

item.title: WhatsApp usernames and BSUID: API changes for business
item.description: WhatsApp is rolling out usernames so customers can chat without sharing a phone number, and businesses will see a new business-scoped user ID in API webhooks instead.

item.title: Codex CLI 0.171.0 and Claude Code 2.1.330 ship the same day
item.description: Codex CLI 0.171.0 and Claude Code 2.1.330 both shipped on November 20, with GPT-6.2 Sol now the default model in Codex.

item.title: Pragmatik Labs raises new round at ~$5B valuation; Oracle fully funds its OpenAI buildout
item.description: Pragmatik Labs raised a new round at about a $5 billion valuation, and Oracle says its OpenAI infrastructure buildout is now fully funded.

item.title: Okta extends MCP governance to every hop of an agent's tool calls
item.description: Okta extended its MCP governance so every step of an AI agent's tool calls is scoped, audited, and tied to the person who requested it.

item.title: Cloudflare Agents SDK v0.34.0 brings Pi 1.6 tools that wait without staying awake
item.description: Cloudflare's Agents SDK now lets AI agent tools wait for a person or a deadline without staying awake and burning compute.

item.title: MCP drafts an experimental file uploads and downloads extension
item.description: The Model Context Protocol published a draft extension for uploading and downloading files outside the model's context.

item.title: Dev week in review: GPT-6.2 coding backlash, Microsoft MAI Code 2, Gemini 4 Neon
item.description: This week's developer digest: GPT-6.2 drew mixed reviews for coding, Microsoft launched MAI Code 2, and Google shipped Gemini 4 Neon.

item.title: First Person Labs exits stealth with ~$10M led by a16z to build per-user models
item.description: First Person Labs came out of stealth with about $10 million led by Andreessen Horowitz to build AI models tuned to each individual user.

item.description: Simplex AI open-sourced Linger, a personal AI agent that runs entirely on your own PC instead of in the cloud.
